subject: planner: use addedRows for out of range and add skew risk ratio (#62363)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The only behavior change in-scope is `pkg/statistics/histogram.go` `(*Histogram).OutOfRangeRowCount`, switching out-of-range estimation to be based on `abs(realtimeRowCount - hg.TotalRowCount())`, adding a `oneValue` lower bound (also used when `modifyCount==0` and in `OptObjectiveDeterminate`), and applying `tidb_opt_risk_range_skew_ratio` to out-of-range estimation. Callers in `pkg/planner/cardinality/row_count_{column,index}.go` clamp final row counts to `[1, realtimeRowCount]` (or `[0, realtimeRowCount]` under fixcontrol), so no correctness/semantics/data-consistency/concurrency issues at Blocker/High severity were identified.
